title: RNA-Seq data analysis, clustering and visualisation tutorial
questions: How to identify differentially expressed genes across multiple experimental conditions?
What are the biological functions impacted by the differential expression of genes?
How to cluster similar samples and genes?
objectives: To learn the principles of the analysis and visualisation of a multidimensional data analysis. We will use RNA-seq data as an example of a multidimensional -omics dataset.
key_points: You have learned to use DESeq2 to identify differentially expressed mRNAs
You have used PCA to identify the most important sources of variation
You have compared different clustering methods to group samples and genes
